report.explanation: All checkout observations returned 200 with mostly low latency; one 344ms outlier aligns with a single slow order call. Traces show healthy downstreams, no errors, and pool size/idle=1. Metrics show zero 502s and no dependency failures. No current evidence establishes a bounded root cause; operator hypothesis of a fault is contradicted by healthy telemetry.
